name: Melio
summary: Melio is a bill payment tool for small businesses. The Go plan is free for one user, and paid plans run from $25 to $80 a month on monthly billing, or $20 to $64 on annual billing. Each payment has its own fee: a $0.50 ACH payment after the plan's monthly free allowance, $1.50 for a check, and 2.9% for a card.

facts.text: Melio says bills can be added by camera upload, email sync or manual entry, and that it extracts the key details.
Melio's approval workflow page says multi-level workflows can be set up, and that only the owner, admins and accountants can create them.
Melio says it undergoes an annual SOC 2 Type II audit and lists ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and that its card processor is certified PCI Level 1.
Free ACH payments per month are 5 on Go, 20 on Core, 50 on Boost and unlimited on Unlimited.
Core, Boost and Unlimited show $0 for the first 90 days before the paid price starts.

plans.name: Go
plans.notes: Free forever, limited to one user, with 5 free ACH payments a month

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: $20 a month on annual billing. Extra users $10 a month ($8 annual). 20 free ACH payments a month

plans.name: Boost
plans.notes: $44 a month on annual billing. Extra users $10 a month ($8 annual). 50 free ACH payments a month

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: $64 a month on annual billing. Unlimited users and unlimited free ACH payments

hiddenCosts: ACH payments beyond the monthly free allowance cost $0.50 each, and a standard check costs $1.50.
Paying by credit or debit card costs 2.9%; fast check is $20, overnight check is $50, and same-day ACH is 1% (maximum $75).
Global ACH payments in USD carry a $20 flat fee.
